name: Parcel
summary: A complete file upload box with drag and drop, paste, thumbnails and live progress bars
about: A ready-to-use upload box for real forms. Drag files in, browse for them or paste a screenshot; each file gets a row with a thumbnail or type badge, its real size and a striped progress bar with time left. Wrong types and files over 10 MB are rejected, failed uploads can be retried, and sending seals the parcel with confetti.
how: Drag files onto the box (the edges march and the parcel flaps open), click browse, or paste with Ctrl+V
Each file slides in with its own row: image thumbnails show, other files get a coloured badge
Progress bars fill with the real file size, speed and time left; a check draws when done
Files that are too big or not allowed turn red; a dropped upload shows a retry button
Remove or cancel files with ×, then press Send files to seal the parcel, or Start over
To see the Retry button, pick a file with "fail" in its name: its first upload drops halfway, and Retry finishes it.
